plaatsen.tekst: Then Abraham gave up the ghost, and died in a good old age, an old man, and full of years; and was gathered to his people.
And Isaac gave up the ghost, and died, and was gathered unto his people, being old and full of days: and his sons Esau and Jacob buried
They that were full have hired out themselves for bread; and they that were hungry ceased: so that the barren hath born seven; and she that hath many children is waxed feeble.
And he died in a good old age, full of days, riches, and honour: and Solomon his son reigned in his stead.
If I be wicked, woe unto me; and if I be righteous, yet will I not lift up my head. I am full of confusion; therefore see thou mine affliction;
Man that is born of a woman is of few days, and full of trouble.
So Job died, being old and full of days.
The full soul loatheth an honeycomb; but to the hungry soul every bitter thing is sweet.
And of Naphtali he said, O Naphtali, satisfied with favour, and full with the blessing of the LORD: possess thou the west and the south.
The fear of the LORD tendeth to life: and he that hath it shall abide satisfied; he shall not be visited with evil.
